title.narrative: Pathway 2 Young Women Leadership in Palestine

description.narrative: Pathway 2 of the YW4A programme has the objective of enhancing the leadership of 13,700 young women (YW) to effectively engage in collective action and decision-making in public, private, and civic spaces in Palestine, Egypt, Kenya, and South Sudan by 2025.

title.narrative: IO2a - # young women, with 60 % from marginalised communities, assuming leadership roles in public and civic decision-making at community level (disaggregated by cohort).

description.narrative: Outcome indicator- Number of young women who are trained TOT and who experience changes in leadership skills, experiences and practices.

title.narrative: # young women, with 60 % from marginalised communities, assuming leadership roles in public and civic decision-making at community level (disaggregated by cohort).- Aspiring

description.narrative: A Young Woman Leadership Score was created with three broad categories: Experienced; denoting high levels of acquiring the conditions for and the exercise of leadership; Aspiring; referring to young women who have potential for assuming leadership roles and; Starting which includes young women who are in the early stages of their leadership journey.This indicator shows the measure of Aspiring

comment.narrative: A Young Woman Leadership Score was created which is an individualised aggregated measure of leadership capacity. The scale includes the following categories, arranged from the highest to the lowest: A. Very Skilful, B. Skilful, C. Strongly Emerging, D. Emerging, E. Limited and F. Basic. These categories are grouped under three large classifications as the following: Experienced including categories A and B; denoting high levels of acquiring the conditions for and the exercise of leadership; Aspiring including categories C and D; referring to young women who have potential for assuming leadership roles and; Starting including categories E and F; which includes young women who are in the early stages of their leadership journey. This indicator shows the measure of Aspiring

This indicator is measured using the Leadership Capacity Assessment Tool, administered at the beginning of the program (baseline) and at its conclusion (endline). This value reflects the actual endline result.

This indicator is measured using the Leadership Capacity assessment tool, administered both at the beginning (Baseline) and again at the end of the program (Endline). Currently, the actual value is recorded as 0, pending the materialization of the the endline study. Once the endline assessment is conducted, a new period will be added, including the actual values.
